parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: `zh` (Chinese) and `en` (English). The default value is `zh`.

parameters.name: AuthResourceConfig
parameters.description: The YAML configuration for the advanced mode.

parameters.name: AuthResourceList
parameters.description: The list of authorization rules. Multiple rules are evaluated with a logical OR. Within a single rule, multiple match conditions are evaluated with a logical AND.

sub_parameters.name: AuthResourceHeaderList
sub_parameters.description: A list of request header conditions to match. This parameter is applicable only to custom authentication rules.

sub_parameters.name: DomainId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the domain name to which the rule applies.

sub_parameters.name: IgnoreCase
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether path matching is case-sensitive. This parameter is applicable only to custom authentication rules. For other authentication methods, path matching is case-sensitive by default.

- `true`: Path matching is case-insensitive.

- `false`: Path matching is case-sensitive.

sub_parameters.name: MatchType
sub_parameters.description:
The match type for the path. Valid values:

- EQUAL: Exact match

- PRE: Prefix match

- REGEX: Regular expression match

parameters.name: AuthResourceMode
parameters.description:
The mode for configuring authorization resources. Valid values:

- 0: Simple mode

- 1: Advanced mode

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The client ID of the application registered with the identity provider. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`.

parameters.name: ClientSecret
parameters.description: The client secret of the application registered with the identity provider. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`.

parameters.name: CookieDomain
parameters.description:
The cookie domain. After successful authentication, the gateway sends a cookie to this domain to keep the user signed in.

For example, if you set `Cookie-domain=a.example.com`, the cookie is sent to the `a.example.com` domain. If you set `Cookie-domain=.example.com`, the cookie is sent to `example.com` and its subdomains.

parameters.name: ExternalAuthZJSON
parameters.description: The settings for the custom authentication service.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: IsWhite
parameters.description:
Specifies the authorization mode.

- `true`: Whitelist mode. Requests that match the specified hosts and paths can bypass authentication. All other requests require authentication.

- `false`: Blacklist mode. Requests that match the specified hosts and paths require authentication. All other requests can bypass authentication.

parameters.name: Issuer
parameters.description:
This parameter applies when `Type` is `JWT` or `OIDC`.

- For JWT authentication, this specifies the issuer (`iss`) of the JWT claims.

- For OIDC authentication, this specifies the issuer (`iss`) of the OIDC claims.

parameters.name: Jwks
parameters.description: The JWT public key in JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) format.

parameters.name: LoginUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the user logon page for the IDaaS instance. This parameter is required when `Type` is `IDaaS`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The authentication name.

parameters.name: RedirectUrl
parameters.description: The URL to which the user is redirected after successful authentication. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`. The URL must match the redirect URL configured in the OIDC or IDaaS provider.

parameters.name: ScopesList
parameters.description: The OIDC scopes. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC`.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: This parameter is for internal use and should not be configured. Upon creation, an authentication rule is disabled by default.

parameters.name: Sub
parameters.description: The subject (`sub`) of the JWT claims. This parameter is used when `Type` is `JWT`. Ensure that the value of this parameter matches the `sub` field in the JWT payload. If this parameter is not set or is left empty, its value defaults to the value of the `Issuer` parameter.

parameters.name: TokenName
parameters.description:
The name of the request header that contains the JWT.

The default value is `Authorization`.

parameters.name: TokenNamePrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix for the token value in the header.

The default value is `Bearer `(note the trailing space).

parameters.name: TokenPass
parameters.description: Specifies whether to pass the token to the backend service after successful authentication.

parameters.name: TokenPosition
parameters.description:
Specifies the location of the JWT. Valid value:

- HEADER: The token is in a request header.

By default, the token is read from the `Authorization` header and must be prefixed with `Bearer `. For example: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The authentication method. Valid values:

- JWT

- OIDC

- IDaaS

- ExternalAuthZ (custom authentication service)
